summary: RotaPro v2 Shift Scheduler backend testing complete. All 32 tests passed covering: Staff CRUD, Shift entries with auto hours_worked/earned_amount calculation, Bulk actions (copy-week, publish-all, clear-week), Payroll summary aggregation, Conflict detection (weekly_overtime, double_booking), Occupancy-based staffing needs, AI auto-schedule (suggest + apply with deterministic fallback), Leave requests CRUD + TR Is Kanunu balance, Clock-in/out events, Open shifts + claim, Sync to salaries.
critical_code_review_comments: shifts.py: Auto-calculation of hours_worked and earned_amount working correctly (8h shift * 25 TRY/h = 200 TRY)
Conflict detection properly identifies weekly_overtime (>45h TR limit) and double_booking (same date 2 shifts)
AI suggest returns deterministic fallback when LLM unavailable - round-robin assignment by role
Leave balance correctly implements TR Is Kanunu entitlement (default 14 days)
Clock-out computes actual_hours from clock_in timestamp
Open shift claim atomically updates status to 'claimed' with claimed_by field
seed_data_creation: Test staff (receptionist, housekeeper, maintenance) created and cleaned up during tests. Shift entries, leave requests, clock events, open shifts all created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RotaPro v2 Shift Scheduler fully tested.
